what_is_required_and_pre_registered: R-1 A SWEEP OVER A RANGE OF p: EIGHT WELL-SEPARATED PRIMES AT log2 p IN {20, 23, 26, 29, 32, 35, 38, 40}, each computed in-session by a stated deterministic rule and NONE transcribed.

R-2 A FITTED EXPONENT WITH ERROR BARS: c is obtained by ORDINARY LEAST SQUARES over the sweep, with BOTH a t-distribution interval AND a 2000-resample bootstrap percentile interval, AND THE WIDER OF THE TWO IS THE ONE CARRIED into every downstream statement. Selecting the narrower interval for a headline is forbidden.

R-3 THE RESIDUALS ARE REPORTED IN FULL, SIGNED, PER PRIME, AS A NAMED LIST, plus the residual sign-pattern string, plus R^2, adjusted R^2 and residual standard error, FOR M-A, M-B AND THE NULL MODEL M-0 - SO THAT A BAD FIT IS VISIBLE RATHER THAN HIDDEN IN A SINGLE SLOPE OR A SINGLE R-SQUARED. GOF-1 (max |residual| > 0.5 bit), GOF-2 (a monotone residual run of 6 of 8, i.e. systematic curvature, EVEN AT HIGH R-SQUARED) and GOF-3 (M-A fails to beat the null by a factor of 2 in residual standard error) each DECLARE THE FIT NOT ADEQUATE and forbid reporting an identified exponent.

R-4 STABILITY UNDER B: c IS FITTED SEPARATELY AT THREE SMOOTHNESS BOUNDS (B-ASY, B-FIX-8, B-FIX-32) AND ALL THREE ARE REPORTED WITH INTERVALS. IF THE THREE INTERVALS ARE PAIRWISE DISJOINT, c IS NOT AN EXPONENT, IT IS AN ARTIFACT OF THAT REGIME, AND THE REPORT SAYS EXACTLY THAT.

R-5 STABILITY UNDER IMPLEMENTATION: c IS FITTED SEPARATELY UNDER TWO GENUINELY DIFFERENT IMPLEMENTATIONS (V-1 modular-polynomial route, V-2 Velu/isogenies_prime_degree route) AT A COMMON B. DISJOINT INTERVALS MEAN c IS A PROPERTY OF THE IMPLEMENTATION AND NOT OF THE ALGORITHM.

R-6 A MACHINE-CALIBRATION CONTROL: a known-complexity operation (F_{p^2} multiplication, F_{p^2} inversion, and an empty interpreter loop) TIMED ACROSS THE SAME p RANGE ON THE SAME HOST IN THE SAME SESSION, INTERLEAVED WITH THE PRIMARY CELLS, AND FITTED WITH THE SAME MODELS - so the fit is separated from host effects, thermal throttling and interpreter overhead. This is the inventor protocol's controls-before-belief obligation applied to a timing measurement.

R-7 A NULL / NEGATIVE CONTROL: two quantities that CANNOT scale with p (SHA-256 of a fixed 4 KiB buffer; dict insert/lookup of 1000 fixed keys), MEASURED IDENTICALLY IN THE SAME WINDOWS AND FITTED IDENTICALLY. IF EITHER SCALES THE SAME WAY THE PRIMARY QUANTITY DOES, THE MEASUREMENT IS PICKING UP SOMETHING OTHER THAN WHAT IT CLAIMS, AND NO c IS CARRIED INTO THE EXTRAPOLATION.

R-8 GAP-1 IS HANDLED EXPLICITLY AND IS NOT LEFT TO THE EXECUTOR. Algorithm 1 as published NEVER SEEDS THE LIST, so it cannot be run at all. TWO SEEDING STRATEGIES ARE PRE-REGISTERED IN EXP-SSI-002 (SEED-A identity, primary; SEED-B first-layer, variant at the two extreme primes), THE CHOICE IS DOCUMENTED PER CELL, ITS COST IS CHARGED AND REPORTED AS seed_seconds, AND ITS EFFECT ON THE MEASURED CONSTANT IS REPORTED - BECAUSE THE UNSEEDED-VS-SEEDED DIFFERENCE LANDS DIRECTLY IN THE CONSTANT THIS BATCH IS MEASURING.

R-9 EVERYTHING IS CHARGED. MODULAR POLYNOMIAL EVALUATION AND ROOT FINDING ARE BOTH COUNTED, AND SO ARE THE NON-BACKTRACKING FILTER AND THE TABLE INSERTION; MEMORY IS REPORTED BESIDE TIME FOR EVERY CELL; SAGE STARTUP IS EXCLUDED FROM EVERY TIMED WINDOW AND STATED SEPARATELY AS sage_startup_seconds; AND PRECOMPUTATION (Phi_ell retrieval) IS REPORTED BOTH AMORTISED AND FULLY CHARGED, WITH BOTH FITS REPORTED AND THE CHOICE NAMED RATHER THAN SILENT.

R-10 THE ISOLATED-ell FIT IS MANDATORY. A pooled per-entry cost mixes a genuine p-dependence with a DRIFTING ell-MIXTURE, because X = B^{1/2}(p/2)^{1/6} grows with p and under B-ASY the bound B moves too. c IS THEREFORE ALSO FITTED RESTRICTED TO ell = 2 ALONE AND TO ell = 3 ALONE ACROSS THE FULL SWEEP. IF THE POOLED AND FIXED-ell SLOPES DISAGREE BEYOND THEIR INTERVALS, THE POOLED c IS AN ARTIFACT OF THE MIXTURE AND THE REPORT MUST SAY SO IN THOSE WORDS.
THE_METHODOLOGICAL_POINT_THAT_DECIDES_WH.the_collinearity_admission_is_made_up_fr: OVER log2 p IN [20, 40], sqrt(log2 p) AND log2(log2 p) ARE NEARLY COLLINEAR, SO EIGHT NOISY POINTS ARE UNLIKELY TO DISCRIMINATE THE TWO CANDIDATE FUNCTIONAL FORMS.
